title: Correlation of Toxins With Gastrointestinal (GI) and Overall Health
official: Association of Presenting Symptoms and Diagnosis, With Urinary Mycotoxins, Metals, Polyfluorinated Alkyl Substance (PFAS) and Environmental Toxins - A Prospective Study in an Urban Gastroenterology Practice
summary: The goal of this observational study is to evaluate the levels of urinary environmental toxins, heavy metals, PFAS and mycotoxins with gastrointestinal (GI) and overall health.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients suffering from gastrointestinal and/or other symptoms
* Patients willing to provide urine samples
* Patients willing to provide consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Use of antibiotics 2 weeks prior to the study
* Patients unwilling to consent
